"Sail On" is a Commodores song written by Lionel Richie from their 1979 album Midnight Magic.
Released as the first of three singles from the album, it was produced by both Commodores and James Anthony Carmichael.
The song reached the top ten on both the US and UK music charts that same year.
Greatest Hits is an album by the Commodores, released on Motown Records in 1978.
19 on the UK Pop Albums chart and has been certified Gold by the British Phonographic Industry.
